attributes.title: 2027 MVMA Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The Minnesota VMA holds its 2027 Annual Conference February 10 to 13, 2027, at the Hilton Minneapolis. The conference site lists more than 140 CE hours for veterinarians, veterinary technicians and assistants, practice managers and students.

Attendee registration is open. The three-day rate for MVMA members and non-Minnesota veterinarians is $390 through January 5, 2027, $425 from January 6 to 25 and $460 after that; Minnesota non-member veterinarians pay $715, $750 and $785, and technicians and staff $340, $375 and $410. DVM students register free until the late period. Two-day and one-day rates are also listed. The Hilton Minneapolis room rate is $135 plus taxes, with self-parking included.
